title: A Sea of Stars
intro: The final restoration is a map of six safe passages, with two examples of each craft. No single solution should own the sea. Finish the survey, and leave the horizon open.
completion: At dawn, the whole harbor answers. The sea has not become smaller; it has become navigable. Your restoration is complete. Keep charting, revisit a favorite challenge, or let the lights watch over the water until you return.
hints: Complete two distinct dossiers from each family.
Six optional dossiers, extra plan slots and decorations can remain unpurchased.
